title: English Catalog and FAQ
subtitle: Products, MOQ, logo printing, lead time, samples, claims and export documents

facts.statement: All dates and times in this guide use Thailand time (Asia/Bangkok).
The Thai-language documents (SS-POLICY, SS-CAT-BOTTLES and others) contain the full details; this guide is a summary.
The website can be switched between Thai and English with the TH/EN button.
SaiSai Glassware was founded in 2015 (B.E. 2558) and makes glass bottles for beverages, honey and cosmetics.
The factory is located in a test industrial estate in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan, Thailand (fictitious address).
Total production capacity is about 120,000 bottles per day on 3 forming lines.
The factory is certified to ISO 9001 (since 2018) and GMP for food packaging (since 2020).
SaiSai sells to business customers (B2B) only; one company account can have several users.
Each user can only see orders, claims and quotations of their own company.
All bottles are soda-lime glass (Type III), lead-free and 100% recyclable.
The glass contains about 30% recycled cullet.
Health drinks and juices: B-250 and B-500 in clear or amber.
Energy drinks and health shots: B-100 and B-150 in amber.
Honey: B-250 amber is the most recommended bottle; B-500 amber for family size.
evidence: B-250 amber is the most recommended

facts.statement: Cosmetics (serum, toner, essential oils): B-100 and B-150.
Product P01 is the B-100 clear bottle (100 ml, slug b100-clear).
Product P02 is the B-100 amber bottle (100 ml, slug b100-amber).
Product P03 is the B-150 clear bottle (150 ml, slug b150-clear).
Product P04 is the B-150 amber bottle (150 ml, slug b150-amber).
Product P05 is the B-250 clear bottle (250 ml, slug b250-clear).
Product P06 is the B-250 amber bottle (250 ml, slug b250-amber).
Product P07 is the B-250 green bottle (250 ml, slug b250-green).
Product P08 is the B-500 clear bottle (500 ml, slug b500-clear).
Product P09 is the B-500 amber bottle (500 ml, slug b500-amber).
Green glass is available for the B-250 only (footnote ¹ of Table 2.2).
evidence: ¹ Only the B-250 is available in green.

facts.statement: Amber glass is available for all 4 models.
The B-100 is 98 mm tall and 45 mm in diameter.
The B-100 weighs 95 g (empty) and has a 28 mm neck.
The B-150 is 118 mm tall and 52 mm in diameter.
The B-150 weighs 130 g (empty) and has a 28 mm neck.
The B-250 is 150 mm tall and 60 mm in diameter.
The B-250 weighs 190 g (empty) and has a 38 mm neck.
The B-500 is 205 mm tall and 75 mm in diameter.
The B-500 weighs 320 g (empty) and has a 43 mm neck.
The B-500 uses a 43 mm lug finish for metal twist caps (1/4 turn).
The B-100 and B-150 share the same 28 mm neck, so they can use the same caps.
SaiSai does not sell caps; customers source caps that match the neck finish.
Amber glass blocks more than 90% of UV light between 300 and 400 nm.
All bottles withstand a thermal shock of at least 42 °C.
Hot filling is allowed up to 85 °C if bottles are pre-heated to at least 45 °C.
The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-100 is 2,400 bottles.
The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-150 is 1,800 bottles.
The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-250 is 1,200 bottles.
The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for the B-500 is 800 bottles.
Quantities must be in steps of 100 bottles.
The maximum is 200,000 bottles per order; larger orders must be arranged with sales.
An identical order from the same company within 10 minutes is treated as a duplicate.
Step 1 Order received
Step 2 Spec confirmation (logo artwork is approved here)
Step 3 In production (prepaid orders must be paid before this step)
Step 4 Quality inspection (AQL sampling)
Step 5 Ready to ship
Step 6 Shipped (the 7-day claim period starts)
An order moves forward one step at a time and cannot skip steps.
Logos are printed by ceramic screen printing and fired at about 600 °C, so the print becomes part of the glass.
Logo printing requires at least 5,000 bottles per order.
The logo printing fee is THB 0.80 per bottle for every model and colour.
The flat fee covers up to 2 positions (front and back) with up to 2 colours per position.
Quantity discounts apply to the bottle amount only, not to logo printing or delivery.
Accepted artwork files are AI (CS6 or later), vector PDF, SVG and EPS; JPG and PNG are reference only.
Text must be converted to outlines and artwork must be at 1:1 scale.
The minimum line width is 0.3 mm and the minimum text height is 1.5 mm.
Artwork is approved at step 2 (Spec confirmation); production cannot start before approval.
A digital proof is sent within 2 working days; 2 revisions are free.
8 standard ceramic ink colours are available; gold and metallic inks are not offered.
The maximum front print area of the B-100 is 40 × 30 mm.
The maximum front print area of the B-150 is 45 × 40 mm.
The maximum front print area of the B-250 is 60 × 55 mm.
The maximum front print area of the B-500 is 80 × 90 mm.
The lead time is 14 days: the pickup date must be at least today + 14 days.
The earliest pickup date skips factory holidays.
Logo printing does not extend the 14-day lead time if artwork is approved by day 3.
Customers can change the pickup date themselves only while the order is at step 1 or 2.
23 Oct 2026 (Chulalongkorn Day) is a factory holiday and cannot be chosen as a pickup date.
5 Dec 2026 (National Father's Day) is a factory holiday and cannot be chosen as a pickup date.
31 Dec 2026 (New Year's Eve) is a factory holiday and cannot be chosen as a pickup date.
One truck trip carries up to 20,000 bottles of any model.
Delivery within 0–50 km is free.
Delivery over 50 km costs THB 1,500 per trip.
Distances over 300 km cannot be priced by the system; please contact sales.
Example: 25,000 bottles delivered 160 km away need 2 trips, so delivery costs THB 3,000.
Customers can collect at the factory Monday–Saturday, 08:30–16:30, free of delivery charge (enter 0 km).
Companies with fewer than 3 shipped orders must pay in full before production (prepay).
After 3 shipped orders, a company gets 30-day credit automatically.
The credit due date is the shipping date + 30 calendar days.
VAT 7% is added to every order and rounded half-up to 2 decimals.
Bank transfer: SaiSai Glassware Co., Ltd. · Test Bank · account 000-0-00000-0.
Cash and personal cheques are not accepted.
Logged-in customers can request a quotation from the order page or from the chatbot Nong Sai.
Quotation numbers look like QT-0001.
A quotation is valid for 7 days from the issue date.
A quotation keeps all price lines as of the issue date and can be converted to an order once.
When converting, all rules are checked again (14-day lead time, holidays, duplicates).
Expired quotations cannot be converted; please request a new one.
Order totals are calculated in this order: bottles − discount + logo + delivery = subtotal, then + VAT 7% = total.
Free samples: up to 3 bottles per model per company per month.
Samples cost THB 0.00 and the quota resets on the first day of each calendar month.
evidence: first day of each calendar month

facts.statement: The sample quota counts by model, not by colour.
Samples are sent by parcel within 5 working days and are not printed with logos.
Claims must be reported within 7 days of the shipping date (shipping day = day 0).
Example: shipped on 12 Oct 2026, claims are accepted until 19 Oct 2026.
A claim needs the lot number in the format LOT- followed by 6 digits, e.g. LOT-261001.
The lot number is printed on the carton side label and on the delivery note, not on the bottle.
Attach 1 to 5 photos, JPG or PNG, each no larger than 5 MB.
Claim status flow: received → reviewing → approved or rejected.
A rejection always includes a reason of 1–1,000 characters.
Damage caused by hot filling above the limit is not covered.
Approved claims receive replacement bottles in the next delivery or a credit note.
The packing list in English shows cartons, pallets and gross weights.
A Certificate of Analysis (CoA) is provided per lot on request within 2 working days.
The food-contact test certificate number is FC-2026-014, valid until 31 Jan 2027.
SaiSai does not issue certificates of origin; the exporter must apply for them.
Export customs clearance is not provided by SaiSai; it is handled by the customer's forwarder.
SaiSai does not ship overseas; export customers collect at the factory or use a domestic forwarder warehouse.
Laem Chabang port is about 95 km from the factory, so delivery there costs THB 1,500 per trip.
Pallets are 120 × 100 cm wooden pallets; no deposit and no return needed.
Pallets can be arranged for 20-foot containers if requested at spec confirmation.
A B-100 carton holds 96 bottles and a full pallet holds 5,760 bottles.
A B-150 carton holds 72 bottles and a full pallet holds 4,320 bottles.
A B-250 carton holds 48 bottles and a full pallet holds 2,400 bottles.
A B-500 carton holds 24 bottles and a full pallet holds 1,152 bottles.
Q: What is the lead time? · A: 14 days from today, skipping factory holidays.
Q: Can I order 2,000 B-100 bottles? · A: No, the MOQ for the B-100 is 2,400.
Q: Can I get a green B-500? · A: No, green is available for the B-250 only.
evidence: green is available for the B-250 only

facts.statement: Q: Can I print a logo on 3,000 bottles? · A: No, logo printing needs at least 5,000 bottles.
Q: How many free samples can I get? · A: 3 per model per month.
Q: How long do I have to report broken bottles? · A: 7 days from shipping.
Q: Do you sell carbonated-drink bottles? · A: No, our bottles are not designed for carbonated drinks.
Q: Are prices listed in this guide? · A: No, see the ordering system or request a quotation.
Sales phone: 02-000-0000 (Mon–Fri 08:30–17:00, Thailand time).
LINE: @saisai-test
The chatbot Nong Sai answers in English when you write or speak in English.

lines: This English guide summarises the products and sales policies of SaiSai Glassware Co., Ltd. for international and English-speaking B2B customers.
Policy numbers in this guide match the shop's ordering system (rules.ts). Bottle prices are not listed; please use the ordering system or request a quotation.
Warning: the company, people, phone numbers and bank account in this document are fictitious test data.
